messages:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up — Tariq Ahmed submitted a resignation this morning. Last day confirmed: 2025-04-18 (Fri). Need coordinated offboard: benefits/COBRA, visa sponsorship wrap, final payroll timing, device return, access removal, and exit interview. @Alejandra @Josh @Maya @Sophie
Tariq Ahmed: Thanks all — I'll make sure notes + outstanding PRs are tidy. Remote on last day but can drop device before EOD.
Nina (People Ops): Great — small checklist request: 1) COBRA packet & benefits end date 2) Visa sponsorship termination + immigration counsel notice 3) Final paycheck + any reimbursements 4) Device pickup/ship instructions 5) Badge and SSO disable times 6) Exit interview window. Assigning below.
Alejandra (Payroll): Benefits end on last active day (2025-04-18). Gusto sends COBRA enrollment email automatically; I will trigger the manual packet for international addresses — target send by 2025-04-30 (within 14 days).
Alejandra (Payroll): Final payroll cutoff for April run is 2025-04-20. Tariq, any outstanding expenses? Please submit by 2025-04-17 EOD so we can include reimbursements on final paycheck.
Tariq Ahmed: I have one March travel expense pending (~$420). I'll upload receipts today. Also note: I have a small relocation stipend question — pinging @Alejandra separately.
Josh (IT): I'll own device and cloud access. Plan: schedule UPS pickup for MacBook + dongles on 04/19 AM (prepaid label). Deprovision timeline on 2025-04-18: freeze elevated/admin at 17:00 PT, revoke AWS keys at 17:30 PT, disable SSO at 18:00 PT.
Josh (IT): For AWS key rotation I will run:
```
# revoke keys for tariq@redwood
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name tariq || true
aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id <AKID> --status Inactive --user-name tariq
```
Maya (Security): Badge will be deactivated 04/18 18:00 PT. Facilities requests placed for mail hold and to accept device drop-off if Tariq prefers in-person return. If shipping, please use the prepaid label Josh will send.
Sophie (Legal): Visa sponsorship note: we need to send the formal termination letter and notify our immigration counsel by EOD tomorrow (2025-03-12). Also confirm there are no outstanding export-controlled projects that require retention hold — @Josh pls confirm list of repos with restricted data.
Josh (IT): Confirmed — Tariq is not on any restricted export projects. I'll DM Sophie the repo list for a quick cross-check.
Finance-Bot: Payroll run reminder: add reimbursable expenses by 2025-04-17 23:59 UTC to be included in final pay cycle on 2025-04-25.
Nina (People Ops): Exit interview options: 04/16 10:00 PT or 04/17 16:00 PT (30m). Tariq, which works?
Tariq Ahmed: 04/17 16:00 PT works best.
Alejandra (Payroll): Noted on the expense timeline. I'll confirm whether pro-rated bonus or commission needs separate approval; will follow up by 04/14.
Nina (People Ops): Quick summary (owners & deadlines): Alejandra — COBRA packet + final payroll confirmation (by 04/14). Josh — device shipping + access removal schedule (by 04/18). Maya — badge deactivation & facilities pickup coordination (by 04/18). Sophie — immigration notice/termination letter (by 03/12). Tariq — submit expense & confirm dropoff preference (by 04/17). I'll run exit interview on 04/17 16:00 PT. Ping here when done so I can close tasks. :thumbsup:
Josh (IT): :thumbsup: I'll post the UPS label and tracking once scheduled.
Alejandra (Payroll): :ok_hand: will update thread when COBRA email sent.
Sophie (Legal): Sending termination draft to Nina & Tariq for sign-off today.
Tariq Ahmed: Thanks everyone — appreciate the help. I'll confirm device return preference later today.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks team — leave any last notes here and I'll convert to the formal offboard checklist in Workday.
